B1.name: Feline Fury
B1.description: Kiara swipes attacks in close range, her quick swoops dealing normal damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Swipes two lightning claws forward, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Pounces upwards and crashes down, dealing small AoE damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Spins quickly with cat claws outstretched and clobbering opponents, ensnaring them in place and dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack.

additional.text: Hold skill before a stage to pounce on target opponent, dealing the Stage’s damage.

S1.name: Lightning God Mode
S1.description: Kiara infuses her basic attacks with yellow lightning that stuns all who come in close vicinity. She gains a power meter with 100 points which remains until all points are consumed.

additional.text: Her Basic Skill is infused with [Wind] damage, her attack speed increasing by +%. Each stage of her Basic Skill used will deplete 2 points and the cost increases by +2 points per stage increment, but resetting when Stage 1 is used again.
Every 15 points depleted will send an AoE [Wind] shockwave equal to % of the value of the last damage dealt (after crits) and inflicting [Electrocute].
{{effect:electrocute}}
Cooldown: 18 seconds
Mana Cost: 130 MP

S2.name: Lynx Prowl
S2.description: Kiara quickens her pace so she strikes before any refute. This skill has 9 charges which can be used anytime.

additional.text: A charge consumed will enable Kiara’s Golden Flash state for 9 seconds if she has it inactive. Each charge used (including first) will increase her movement speed by +20% and all damage from Skills by +% during the state, stackable. Each stage of her Basic Skill unleashed will phase her forward rapidly before dealing the Basic Skill stage’s damage.
Whenever a charge is consumed, Kiara’s health will decrease by -8% and her defense will decrease by -5% for the duration of her Golden Flash state, stacking per charge.
Cooldown: 4 seconds per charge
Mana Cost: 15 MP

U1.name: Electrostasis Pulse
U1.description: Kiara gathers lightning into her palm and lets it free to implode the space around her.

additional.text: The lightning will send a high current in a wide AoE, dealing % of attack as [Wind] damage.
If she has an active power meter, consumes 9 points and the AoE is increased further and, upon use, gains 30% of energy gauge back.
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Lightning Discharge
T1.description: Allies and self with lightning based attacks (stated in skill descriptions, but usually without special effects) will have their respective elements converted to [Lightning Element] damage (applies to all skills that deal elemental damage). Each character whose element is converted will still inherently keep the former’s elements’ buffs, resistances and auras.

additional.text: [Lightning Element]: A special elemental attack which shreds barriers, reducing hit opponent’s defense by -25% when lightning attack lands. The lightning attack will also apply a [Charged] counter on opponents which stack up to 5 times. This element can maintain its lightning element aura for a short time on inflicted opponents.
When this element interacts with water in the environment, it creates a reactive explosion that launches self, allies, and foes a great deal in velocity direction.
{{effect:charged}}
Resonance: No additional effects. Condition remains the same for lightning-based attack requirements.

T2.name: Contamination
T2.description: One of the Eight Forces, now wielded by Kiara herself. If Kiara has unlocked up to 2 unique Special Skills that infuse her Basic Skill with two unique elements, then any Special Skill that has infusion will apply both elements simultaneously to Basic Skill, allowing simultaneous aura application. Only one of these Special Skills need to be equipped.

additional.text: Resonance: No additional effects. Condition remains the same for lightning-based attack requirements.

Dupes.description: Kiara’s movement speed is inversely related to her health where every 1% of health missing from max will increase her movement speed by +1%. Skill damage will increase by each percentage of crit rate over 100% at a 1-to-1 rate. Whenever Kiara damages an opponent with an uninfused skill, she applies [Claw Mark] effect on them.

additional.text: {{effect:claw-mark}}
When the party consists only of [Wind] and [Water] elements, the opponent’s resistance to those elements are reduced by -25% within battle proximity.
Every 200 points of attack stat Kiara has will increase her crit rate by +1%. Her piercing stat increases by +1% for every 5% of crit rate.

The power meter from Special Skill: Lightning God Mode will start with 150 points. Each point missing from the meter when a Basic Skill is used will increase damage by +1%. Her attack speed increases by +0.2% per point on the meter.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
Opponent’s resistance to [Wind] and [Water] elements are further reduced by an additional -25% for the party consisting of only those affinities.

Extra Life: When Kiara would be defeated by a lethal attack, she gains immunity and restores 9% of her health. She additionally gains the effect [Invincibility]. This effect occurs only once per battle.
{{effect:invincibility}}
Increase [Lightning Element] damage for self and allies by +40%.

The Technical Skill: Lightning Discharge is improved: Having [Lightning Element] aura and next damaged by [Water] attacks will increase the instance of hits by +1 for each party member of the inflictor with an element aura on themselves on the battlefield (each element and person is counted once). Having [Water] aura and being hit by [Lightning Element] attack will increase instances based on Kiara’s power meter where every 10 points missing increases the hit instance by +1.
